squirrel.modules.providers.groq.GroqProvider

class squirrel.modules.providers.groq.GroqProvider.GroqProvider(api_env_var, model_name, config, api_key=None)[source]

Bases: IProvider

Groq Provider Class

Description:

This class provides integration with the Groq API to generate text responses, structured responses, JSON responses with schema enforcement, and token usage tracking.

Attributes:

  • model_name (str): The name of the Groq model to use.

  • config (dict): Configuration dictionary for the Groq provider.

  • api_version (str): The version of the API key to use.

  • client (Groq): The initialized Groq client.

Methods:

  • generate_response()

    Generate a response using Groq model

  • generate_structured_response()

    Generate a structured response

  • generate_json()

    Generate a JSON response constrained by a schema

  • available_model_names()

    Get list of available Groq model names

generate_json(input)[source]

Generate a JSON response constrained by a provided schema.

Description:

Sends the schema as a system-level instruction so Groq’s JSON mode produces output that matches the expected structure. Falls back to regex extraction if the model wraps the JSON in markdown fences.

Parameters:

input (Dict[str, Any]) – Input dictionary with keys: - “system_prompt” (str, optional): Additional system instructions - “user_prompt” (str): The user message / task description - “schema” (dict): JSON Schema the response must conform to

Returns:

Parsed JSON response as a Python dict

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

Raises:

ValueError – If the model response cannot be parsed as valid JSON
